releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.15.2 - Battery & dGPU Telemetry Polish:
- Fixed Battery status reporting: Correctly tracks battery percentage, AC/Discharge status, and watt-hour metrics with zero BAT N/A.
- Explicit dGPU labeling in status bar and Dashboard ring gauges (dGPU % vs D3Cold 0.0W Sleep vs iGPU).
- Responsive GPU telemetry polling on both AC and active battery gaming.
